--  Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

--  Data models. Optional properties carry a `Has_` flag beside the value,
--  so every record can be default-initialised and compared with `=`.

with Ada.Containers.Vectors;

with UARP.JSON_Support;
with UARP.Types;

package UARP.Models is

   use UARP.Types;

   subtype JSON_Value is UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   --  Folder closes a cycle in the document's type graph. The vector is
   --  instantiated over an access so the element type is definite while the
   --  record below is still incomplete; From_JSON allocates each element.
   type Folder;
   type Folder_Access is access Folder;
   package Folder_Vectors is new Ada.Containers.Vectors
     (Index_Type => Positive, Element_Type => Folder_Access);

   --  The other half of the cycle.
   type Leaf is record
      Title : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Folders : Boolean := False;
      Folders : UARP.Models.Folder_Vectors.Vector;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Leaf) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Leaf;

   package Leaf_Vectors is new Ada.Containers.Vectors
     (Index_Type => Positive, Element_Type => Leaf);

   --  Mutual recursion: a folder holds entries, an entry holds folders.
   type Folder is record
      Name : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Leaves : Boolean := False;
      Leaves : UARP.Models.Leaf_Vectors.Vector;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Folder) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Folder;

   --  Tree closes a cycle in the document's type graph. The vector is
   --  instantiated over an access so the element type is definite while the
   --  record below is still incomplete; From_JSON allocates each element.
   type Tree;
   type Tree_Access is access Tree;
   package Tree_Vectors is new Ada.Containers.Vectors
     (Index_Type => Positive, Element_Type => Tree_Access);

   --  A node that holds a list of itself - direct recursion.
   type Tree is record
      Label : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Children : Boolean := False;
      Children : UARP.Models.Tree_Vectors.Vector;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Tree) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Tree;

end UARP.Models;

==> src/generated/uarp-models.adb <==
--  Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

package body UARP.Models is

   package JS renames UARP.JSON_Support;

   function To_JSON (Model : Leaf) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "title", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Title));
      if Model.Has_Folders then
         declare
            Items : JS.JSON_Array := JS.JSON.Empty_Array;
         begin
            for Element of Model.Folders loop
               JS.JSON.Append (Items, To_JSON (Element.all));
            end loop;
            JS.Set (Result, "folders", Items);
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Leaf is
      Result : Leaf;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "title") then
         Result.Title := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "title"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "folders") then
         Result.Has_Folders := True;
         declare
            Items : constant JS.JSON_Array := JS.Get_Array (Node, "folders");
         begin
            for Index in 1 .. JS.JSON.Length (Items) loop
               Result.Folders.Append (new Folder'(From_JSON (JS.JSON.Get (Items, Index))));
            end loop;
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

   function To_JSON (Model : Folder) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "name", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Name));
      if Model.Has_Leaves then
         declare
            Items : JS.JSON_Array := JS.JSON.Empty_Array;
         begin
            for Element of Model.Leaves loop
               JS.JSON.Append (Items, To_JSON (Element));
            end loop;
            JS.Set (Result, "leaves", Items);
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Folder is
      Result : Folder;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "name") then
         Result.Name := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "name"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "leaves") then
         Result.Has_Leaves := True;
         declare
            Items : constant JS.JSON_Array := JS.Get_Array (Node, "leaves");
         begin
            for Index in 1 .. JS.JSON.Length (Items) loop
               Result.Leaves.Append (From_JSON (JS.JSON.Get (Items, Index)));
            end loop;
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

   function To_JSON (Model : Tree) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "label", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Label));
      if Model.Has_Children then
         declare
            Items : JS.JSON_Array := JS.JSON.Empty_Array;
         begin
            for Element of Model.Children loop
               JS.JSON.Append (Items, To_JSON (Element.all));
            end loop;
            JS.Set (Result, "children", Items);
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Tree is
      Result : Tree;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "label") then
         Result.Label := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "label"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "children") then
         Result.Has_Children := True;
         declare
            Items : constant JS.JSON_Array := JS.Get_Array (Node, "children");
         begin
            for Index in 1 .. JS.JSON.Length (Items) loop
               Result.Children.Append (new Tree'(From_JSON (JS.JSON.Get (Items, Index))));
            end loop;
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

end UARP.Models;
